prompt: Animate this handcrafted cut-paper salt-making hearth with subtle physical motion. Preserve exactly one wide clay basin resting on the same clay supports, with the small wood fire directly beneath and between them. Make the amber flames flicker gently, the teal brine barely simmer, the white salt crust sparkle softly and thin paper steam curl upward. Add a slow controlled lateral camera drift and slight depth parallax while keeping the basin, supports, fire and shelter geometry stable. No second vessel, no background oven, no new supports, no metal, text, labels, logos, people, object morphing, camera shake, abrupt cuts, giant flames or fast zoom.
